tools.name: list_sessions
tools.title: List conversation sessions
tools.description: List the signed-in user's saved KiboTalk conversation sessions, newest first, with summary and language.

limit.description: How many sessions to return (default 20, max 100).

tools.name: get_session
tools.title: Get a conversation session
tools.description: Fetch one saved KiboTalk session belonging to the signed-in user, including its full transcript turns.

id.description: The session id returned by list_sessions.

tools.name: delete_session
tools.title: Delete a conversation session
tools.description: Permanently delete one saved KiboTalk session belonging to the signed-in user.

id.description: The session id returned by list_sessions.

tools.name: search_emotions
tools.title: Search the emotion library
tools.description: Look up entries in KiboTalk's emotion intelligence library by keyword, emotion name, or scenario, with the recommended response strategy.

query.description: Word or phrase to look for in the emotion, scenario, text pattern, or keywords.

limit.description: How many entries to return (default 10, max 50).
